title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3 hTML injection was possible in Remote Development editor tabs (CVE-2026-123840)
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before version 2026.3 allows HTML injection in Remote Development editor tabs. This could enable an attacker to inject malicious HTML content, potentially affecting the integrity and confidentiality of the editor environment.
